ValidationRule.description: Limit users from Quoting inactive or terminated Dowstream Partners.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Downstream_Reseller__r.Partner_Maturity__c, 'Inactive'), ISPICKVAL(Downstream_Reseller__r.Partner_Maturity__c, 'Terminated'), Downstream_Reseller__r.Active_Account__c = FALSE ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.StageName, 'CLOSED WON')), NOT(ISCLONE()), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The “Downstream Partner” selected is not an authorized Tanium Partner. Please reach out to PartnerOnboarding@tanium.com to verify what is needed to allow this partner to quote.
